description: A level of an enrollment group's agent topology, e.g. a site, an area or a production line. Agent groups nest into themselves and carry the agents assigned to them.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Path segment of this agent group within the unified namespace. Unique among its siblings.
contents.comment: Concatenated with the ancestors' names to form the namespace path, so it is never translated - a path must resolve to the same agent group in every locale. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: ChildAgentGroups
contents.description: Agent groups nested directly below this agent group.
contents.comment: Depth and single-parent are not expressible in DTDL and are enforced by the API: at most six levels below the enrollment group, and exactly one incoming ChildAgentGroups relationship per agent group.

contents.name: Agents
contents.description: Agents assigned to this agent group.
contents.comment: Set an order of magnitude above the intended per-group fan-out because the reserved 'unassigned' agent group is itself an agent group and is exempt from per-group limits - it holds every agent activated without a group. Verified: the node does not enforce maxMultiplicity on write, so this bound documents intent rather than a limit the platform upholds.
